messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.
Effects reported after a sertraline tablet overdose include seizures.
These seizures may be delayed.
Effects reported after a sertraline tablet overdose also include changes in mental state.
These changes include coma.
Heart effects can also be delayed.
They include changes in the electrical activity of the heart.
These changes involve QRS and QTc prolongation.
High blood pressure is seen most often.
Low blood pressure is rare.
It can happen when other substances including alcohol have also been taken.
Serotonin syndrome can occur.
The risk is higher when several drugs that raise serotonin have been taken together.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has overdose effect", "changes in mental state"]

The relation 'has overdose effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity when taken in excessive amounts.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
C. 'has increased risk in': The subject drug may pose a higher risk of adverse effects in the population or group specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
F. None of the above.
